niche: certifying fundable industry-credential attainments for a state CTE incentive from planned concentrator rosters filed by districts
answer: Certify 13,203 fundable industry credential attainments for PY2027-28, supporting an appropriation of 4,951,125 US dollars at the rate of 375 dollars an attainment.
stakeholder_role: the Office of Career and Technical Education, certifying to the State Board

spine.entity: one credential exam sitting by one student
spine.grain: student x credential x sitting date

world.org_type: state department of education office administering a career and technical education credential incentive
invented_names: Tamarack Career and Technical Education Association

driver: The forward count is struck over a register of filings rather than a roll of people, and a unit filed by two filers is one unit allocated by a filed tie-break, so the decisive step is a group-and-rank across filers no column expresses, the overlap small in the fit window and large forward so the back-test cannot see it.
driver_concrete: 2,879 of the 23,832 PY2027-28 concentrators are filed by both the district they leave and the one they join; terms 2.1 makes each one concentrator with a filing-date then district tie-break, and basis R-05 at k = 3 over the deduplicated exposure certifies 13,203 attainments against 15,007 when every filing counts.
stump: A competent solver counts every filing on the planned rosters, so a student filed by the district they leave and the one they join counts twice, and certifies 15,007 (13.7 per cent high); the back-test cannot see it because the overlap is 2.1 to 4.3 per cent in the fit window against 12.1 forward.

lineage.fate: round 1: one live response filed the answer (7,849) by recovering the three-year run length from the settlement record
lineage.driver: Which units sit inside a forward certification turns on a coverage run length that no file states and that a back-test of candidate terms against settled payments selects from an enumerable menu.

lineage.fate: solved by both responses with every graded cell reproduced (answer 5,139)
lineage.driver: Forward exposure is netted of outcomes the units already hold, a filed clause the solver executed on the fit window and the forward roster alike, while a cell-grain settlement file validated every eligibility join at once.

lineage.architecture: v3 (settlement shipped at district and year grain only)
lineage.fate: solved by both responses, every graded cell reproduced (answer 12,392)
lineage.driver: The same eligibility, coverage and netting rungs with the cell-grain settlement detail withheld, so the eligibility rules could no longer be validated row by row against the payments.

lineage.fate: solved anyway (answer 13,298) after spring executions were put on a cadence the corpus could not refuse
lineage.driver: Each agreement has to be dated to the program year it was executed in rather than its calendar year, which moves spring executions forward a year and changes the covered set.
